name: Adventure Mode levels are picked freely; loot history gates only one-shot challenges
contract: Adventure Mode (211) is a difficulty ladder, not a run: a level is entered at whichever tier the player picks, with no earlier level completed. A character that has already looted can still pick a tier - the loot-interaction requirement both Ascension's client data and this world's definition carry for the mode is a clean-start gate for one-shot challenges (Slow and Steady, 601) and is not enforced against a ladder, whose whole loop is dungeon loot. The remaining refusal is the real one: a character that has gained experience cannot enter the mode, and every refusal is answered in words, never with the raw condition name.
